annotations.title: What changed in the Medicare Physician Fee Schedule this quarter? RVU, status, conversion-factor, GPCI and OPPS-cap change records between CMS releases, 2025 on, computed by Distill from CMS’s RVU files

description: What changed in the Medicare Physician Fee Schedule this quarter? RVU, status, conversion-factor, GPCI and OPPS-cap change records between CMS releases, 2025 on, computed by Distill from CMS’s RVU files. Change records between consecutive CMS relative value file releases (2025A on): a code’s RVUs, status or global days; a code added or dropped; the conversion factors; a locality’s GPCIs; the OPPS cap prices. Each record cites the sha256 of both release files. Pages of up to 100, oldest first; pass next_cursor back as cursor. Updated quarterly. Price: $0.05 per call. Free tier: 3 free calls a day per IP, at most 3 rows per answer, taken by an unpaid call unless its _meta["distill/free-tier"] is "skip". Confidence: Freshness only (the amounts and change records are computed from the CMS files deterministically): 1 until the first day of the calendar quarter after the files were last checked, then halving every 30 days. Medicare Physician Fee Schedule amounts computed from CMS’s published RVU, GPCI and conversion-factor files: what Original Medicare allows a participating clinician (before deductible and coinsurance), not what another payer pays; not a quote, not medical, billing or coding advice. See /terms. CPT® codes are served as codes only: their descriptors are AMA copyright and are never included (nor dental CDT descriptors). CPT is a registered trademark of the American Medical Association. HCPCS Level II descriptions are CMS’s.
